document.title: Austin Reaves assists without Dončić · LAL @ LAC
document.footnote: CourtAI reports facts; this is the author's view.

blocks.text: Dončić is out tonight, and the books have already moved Reaves’s assists from 5.5 to 6.5 and 7.5. The question is whether the new line still sits below the role he plays without Dončić. **At 6.5 it does; 7.5 needs his full role.**

blocks.title: Austin Reaves o6.5 AST
blocks.subtitle: FanDuel −140 · LAL @ LAC, 10:30 PM ET
blocks.key: 8.0 AST in 10 games without Dončić (7/10 over 6.5)

blocks.text: With Dončić off the floor last season, Reaves’s usage rose from 21.4% to **34.5%** and his assists per 36 from 4.8 to **7.3** (669 minutes without him). In the 10 games Dončić missed he averaged 8.0 assists, including four on *reduced minutes* in which he still had 7, 8, 6 and 9.
Alongside Dončić he is creating 12.5 potential assists a game, more than he did without him last season, and LAC are only a mild headwind.

blocks.title: What loses it
blocks.text:
- A blowout, or the offense running through someone else, costs him minutes or touches.
- LAC allow the 8th-fewest rim assists, where 44% of his assists go.
- LeBron has left: last season’s without-Dončić games still had a second creator, so the split comes from a different roster.
